purpose: Estimate the probability of a positive five-session gold return; research assistance, not an execution system.
source: HistData Generic ASCII M1 bid OHLC; fixed EST (UTC-5), no DST; no usable volume or ask prices

target.entry: next retained weekday bar open, at most 30 minutes after fixed EST midnight
target.label: exit > entry

validation.method: expanding historical fit, predict one full next year
validation.purge: training target exit strictly before validation first decision timestamp
validation.selection: smallest pooled development Brier loss; tie by candidate id
validation.rule_selection: training folds only; selected rule is one pipeline candidate
validation.final_test: one frozen winner plus fixed baselines, no retuning after test
validation.uncertainty: paired circular block bootstrap, 20 observations per block, 2000 draws
validation.success: test Brier improvement vs fit-frequency baseline with 95% block interval strictly positive and improvement in each test year

limits: Bid-only data cannot establish executable net returns
Provider history is not independently certified
A failed final test requires a new future holdout, not repeated tuning on these years
